name: Newton to Ringo no Ki
original_name: ニュートンと林檎の樹
source:
"'Newton' was actually the pen name of a brilliant-minded girl!?"

Protagonist Asanaga Shuuji and his childhood friend Utakane Yotsuko, whilst tracking down Shuuji's missing grandfather, unexpectedly ended up travelling through time.
What they witnessed upon their arrival was the presence of a single girl right in front of them.

This particular girl would go on to be dubbed as the father of modern-day science, Sir Isaac Newton!
That's correct, Newton turned out to be a small, flat-chested girl!
Unaware of this, Shuuji loudly crashed into the apple tree right in front of the girl.

"Just now... I came up with something that might be incredibly ground-breaking, you know!?"

It was at the moment our main couple travelled through time, right then and there, that Newton discovered universal gravitation!
And just like that, through Shuuji's witless conduct, the great scientific discoveries of that century had all crumbled to ashes.
What's more, like the domino effect, this would gradually end up altering key points in history.

It is now sometime during the 17th century!
The story is set at a prestigious English university called "Tenbridge University",
named for the fact that it spans a total of ten bridges!

Will Shuuji ever be able to rectify history and return to the present!?

[Edited from [url=http://solpress.co/projects/newton//]Sol Press Website[/url]]
translation:
“‘牛顿’居然是一个聪明女孩的笔名！？”

主人公浅永修二和儿时好友歌根四子在寻找修二失踪的祖父的过程中，意外地穿越了时空。
当他们到达时，他们看到的是一个女孩就在他们面前。

这个特别的女孩后来被称为现代科学之父艾萨克·牛顿爵士！
没错，牛顿原来是个平胸小姑娘！
修二没有意识到这一点，大声地撞到了女孩面前的苹果树上。

“刚才……我想出了一些可能是令人难以置信的突破性的东西，你知道吗！？”

就在我们的主要夫妇穿越时空的那一刻，牛顿发现了万有引力！
就这样，在修二的愚蠢行为下，那个世纪的伟大科学发现全部化为灰烬。
更重要的是，就像多米诺骨牌效应一样，这将逐渐改变历史的关键点。

现在是17世纪的某个时候！
故事发生在英国一所著名大学“天桥大学”，
因其横跨十座桥梁而得名！

修二能否纠正历史，回到现在！？
